> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Technical Security Notice:** If this report involves an authentication bypass, data leak, remote code execution, or technical security vulnerability, **do NOT use this public issue form**.
> Please report security vulnerabilities privately via [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/j-nilesh/marmalade/security).

### Safety Concern Category
- [ ] Model behavioral drift or sycophancy
- [ ] Age-inappropriate response in child workspace (ages 6–15)
- [ ] Helpline / crisis intervention phrasing or regional contact inaccuracy
- [ ] PII filter edge case or false positive
- [ ] Study Nook homework answering (doing work instead of Socratic coaching)
- [ ] Other safety or pedagogical concern

### Provider / Setup Context
- **Provider Used:** (e.g. Local Ollama llama3.2, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Demo Mode)
- **Activity Mode:** (e.g. Question Room, Field Guide, Study Nook, Game Loft)
- **Configured Child Age:** (e.g. 10)

### What Happened?
Describe what prompt was entered and what unexpected or concerning behavior occurred. (Please do NOT include real personal child names or sensitive family information).

### Expected Safe Behavior
Describe what response or guardrail intervention should have happened instead.
